verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's evidence pack covers indexing, ranking, hybrid search, security, self-hosting, and an MCP integration for natural-language tool calls, but nothing describes autonomous background automations, scheduled jobs, triggers, or agent workflows that run independently of a user request. The MCP server (docs-13/17, probe-4, probe-rt-3) is a synchronous tool interface invoked per request, not a background automation runner.
